intent_movement: Describe the movement the UI must make visible, not the result it should sell.

left.purpose: Show current plane, direction, freshness and accepted surface.
Show current tensions, intensities, filters and alerts.

right.purpose: Explain how the current state was reached.
Answer from selected domain state and runtime context.

tabs.purpose: Primary domain state: what is alive, blocked, stale or ready.
tabs.use_when: Always present. It is the first read for the domain.

tabs.purpose: Relations between hypotheses, sources, nulls, tools and constraints.
tabs.use_when: Enable when relations or dependency chains are central to the domain.

tabs.purpose: Latest report, falsifier, trajectory, health and runtime readback.
tabs.use_when: Enable when the operator must inspect why the last cycle moved.

tabs.purpose: Findings, claim-cards, packages, value artifacts and maturity gates.
tabs.use_when: Enable only when the domain has value-facing artifacts or promotion gates.

tab_strategy.selection_rule: Choose tabs from domain intent and required observables. Do not expose generic tabs that have no domain-native data source.
tab_strategy.anti_duplication_rule: Prefer adapting an existing tab id over creating a synonym. Add a new tab only when its data source, decision use and operator question are distinct.

value_artifact_contract.reason: New Labs should expose small machine-readable readback artifacts before relying on report prose.

autonomous_value_contract.required_when: The Lab is expected to produce value or actions independently.
autonomous_value_contract.reason: A value-producing Lab must expose its autonomy stage before an operator or another Lab treats its output as work product.

<sidebar-key>.title: Domain-native tooltip title
<sidebar-key>.body: What this UI count means in the domain.
<sidebar-key>.logic: How the operator should interpret it without contaminating the domain.

common_modules.reason: Every Lab needs current field awareness.
Every Lab must show what does not hold.
The operator must see how the cycle moved, not just what it produced.

domain_modules.blocks: What contamination or false inference this module prevents.

admin_actions.boundary: Run from current seed/context. Do not override direction unless explicitly reviewed.
Requires reviewed source, hypothesis, falsifier and domain contract.

forbidden_labels: Replace with labels that would contaminate this domain before review.

e2e.expectation: A completed cycle updates data consumed by at least one left, one center and one right module.
The UI can show tools called, skipped steps, suspensions and accepted surface.
